title: Deep Integration with Local Ecosystem: Apple and Alibaba Partner to Develop a China-specific Large Model

content_html:
Apple, which has been facing pressure on sales and market share in the competitive Chinese market, is quietly adjusting its artificial intelligence strategy in China. According to insiders, Apple has specifically trained a dedicated large language model for the Chinese market, and this breakthrough was achieved through a deep collaboration with Alibaba, which provided technical support for the core model training.

Before this, it was widely expected that Apple would introduce domestic third-party large models to enable generative AI features on devices like iPhones sold in China. Although Apple adopted a strategy of combining its own technology with overseas large models such as OpenAI and Anthropic in the U.S. market, these foreign AI products were unable to directly enter the Chinese market due to various reasons. This move of collaborating with a local tech giant to develop a dedicated model marks a complete change in Apple's traditional approach.

According to current plans, Apple's full set of AI tools, Apple Intelligence, will officially launch in China with an iOS system update in several months. By developing and adapting a large model to the Chinese context, Apple not only maintains full control over the AI product experience in China but also becomes the first foreign tech company to adopt a dual-track AI deployment strategy in China. Additionally, it will be the first foreign company to obtain domestic regulatory approval and launch its own dedicated large model in China.

content_html_zh:
在竞争激烈的中国市场中一直面临销量和市场份额压力的苹果公司正在悄然调整其在中国的人工智能战略。 据内部人士透露，苹果专门训练了针对中国市场的专用大语言模型，而这一突破是通过与阿里巴巴的深度合作实现的，阿里巴巴为核心模型训练提供了技术支持。

此前，人们普遍预计苹果将引入国内第三方大型模型，在中国销售的 iPhone 等设备上启用生成式 AI 功能。 尽管苹果在美国市场采取了将自有技术与OpenAI、Anthropic等海外大模型相结合的策略，但这些国外AI产品由于种种原因未能直接进入中国市场。 此次与本土科技巨头合作开发专用机型的举动，标志着苹果传统做法的彻底改变。

按照目前的计划，苹果的全套人工智能工具Apple Intelligence将在几个月内随着iOS系统更新正式在中国上市。 通过开发和适应中国国情的大模型，苹果不仅保持了对中国人工智能产品体验的完全控制，而且成为第一家在中国采取双轨人工智能部署策略的外国科技公司。 此外，它将成为第一家获得国内监管部门批准并在中国推出自己的专用大型车型的外国公司。
